extractions.statement: No scientific runtime, no real model weights, no real SAE, no real feature manifest, and no real concept bundle were imported. Every file above was copied verbatim (byte-for-byte, hash-verified at import time) from the single source commit recorded in source_repository.commit. The two fixture bundles included in sae_concept_lab/fixtures/ are entirely invented data, explicitly marked is_synthetic=true and release_blocked=true in their own JSON, and every id/label/coefficient in them is a placeholder. This repository's only backend is StubConceptLabBackend, a deterministic, GPU-free stand-in that tags every response '[FAKE STUB -- UI TEST ONLY]'. qwen-sae-interp's real interplab/**, scripts/legacy/**, scientific manifests, results, model files, SAE files, and real bundles were not imported, are not referenced, and are not reachable from this repository's import graph.

supersedes_previous_extraction.reason: Deliberate re-extraction to the final evidence contract, per the Engineer 4 P0 dispatch that also required product-side full-digest-publication enforcement. Between the previous frozen pack (fabf702) and this one, qwen-sae-interp corrected RepositoryEvidenceRegistry.resolve() at commit 5332963 ('Verify evidence by content, not by what the artifact says about itself') to read a registry artifact's bytes and recompute its content digest, rather than trusting the artifact's own self-declared self_hash field -- this closes the exact canonical-source gap this repository's provenance/BOUNDARY.md previously disclosed as a known limitation of the mirrored fabf702 pack. Commit 3a9c153 additionally ratified REQUIRE_FULL_DIGEST_FOR_PUBLICATION (publication needs the full sha256:<64 lowercase hex> form; a 12-hex prefix still resolves in development but never publishes), constrained artifact_type to a case-canonical lowercase registry directory name (ARTIFACT_TYPE_RE), and shipped the mandatory RELEASE_EVIDENCE_STATEMENT wording and its inline digest labels as canonical constants.
supersedes_previous_extraction.history_preserved_via: This repository's own git history, not this file: the previous extraction's record (frozen_pack_commit fabf702, checkout cdae9c7) remains readable at commit d7e4577 and earlier via `git show d7e4577:provenance/source_import.json`. This is a new commit superseding that record, never a rewrite of it.

extracted_artifacts.source_commit_note: Overrides source_repository.checkout_commit (3a9c153) for THIS entry only: export_inventory.json's frozen_at_commit field is stamped by the immediately-following commit, since a commit cannot name its own hash inside a file it contains, so the byte-for-byte source for this one file is frozen_pack_commit (2a95a49), not checkout_commit. vectors.json and all eight modules are byte-identical at both commits (verified independently at import time), so checkout_commit is the correct, unoverridden source for every other entry in this extraction. provenance/verify_provenance.py reads this per-entry source_commit field when present.

mechanical_adaptations.note: Zero byte-level adaptations. All eight canonical modules use package-relative imports exclusively (dot-prefixed, e.g. 'from .schema import ...', never an absolute 'interplab.concept_bundle.schema' form) for every internal cross-reference, confirmed by grepping the extracted source for absolute interplab.concept_bundle.* imports before extraction (zero found). A relative import resolves within its own package regardless of that package's dotted path, so the eight files import correctly unmodified under sae_concept_lab.canonical.concept_bundle exactly as they did under interplab.concept_bundle. This is recorded explicitly (not left as an empty list with no explanation) because absence of adaptation is itself a claim that needs to be checkable, not assumed.

behavioral_consequences_of_unchanged_byt.description: REGISTRY_ROOT is computed as Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'registry' -- an absolute default relative to the file's own location, found by grepping all eight files for Path(__file__)/parents[ usage (the only such occurrence; codec.py's BUNDLES_DIR is a plain relative path, unaffected by relocation). Under interplab/concept_bundle/evidence.py, parents[2] is the qwen-sae-interp repository root, so the unqualified default resolves to the real, populated registry/ tree. Under sae_concept_lab/canonical/concept_bundle/evidence.py, parents[2] is sae_concept_lab/ (the package directory, not the product repository root), so the identical, byte-for-byte-unchanged code now resolves this default to sae_concept_lab/registry -- a path that does not exist in this repository and never will, since no registry data is ever shipped here. RepositoryEvidenceRegistry() called with no explicit root therefore resolves every reference UNRESOLVABLE (fail-closed by construction, matching the module's own documented behavior for 'no registry available'), never accidentally resolving against a directory that happens to exist. Every caller in this repository's tests passes an explicit root (or uses InMemoryEvidenceRegistry/NullEvidenceRegistry), so nothing here depends on this default in practice -- recorded because the byte-identical file now has a different DEFAULT ARGUMENT VALUE at a different nesting depth, which is a real behavioral fact about relocation even though no line of code was changed.

conformance_check.how_run: Run twice, independently: (1) verify_pack() called directly in-process against the copied runner and the copied vectors.json (no qwen-sae-interp checkout required -- this is the path the standalone test suite uses); (2) the exact documented CLI form, executed from a detached git worktree of qwen-sae-interp at commit 3a9c153 (created and removed via 'git worktree add/remove', which never touches the main qwen-sae-interp checkout's HEAD, index, or tracked files), using this repository's own installed package as --package. Both runs agree.

extractions.statement: No scientific concept, feature membership, calibration value, or evidence artifact was imported. The eight modules extracted here are the concept-bundle CONTRACT ONLY -- schema, codec, typed refusals, execution grouping, resolution arithmetic, evidence-reference resolution, and the publication gate -- not any concept data. interplab/concept_bundle/fixtures.py (invented data), scripts/concept_bundle_conformance.py's role as a verification harness (copied here for the record and to run the check, not as runtime surface), and tests/concept_bundle_helpers.py (test-only construction) were deliberately excluded, matching export_inventory.json's own excluded_from_minimum_surface list. The extracted package is standard-library-only (confirmed both by the canonical export_inventory.json's runtime_dependencies list and by this repository's own isolation tests) and has no import-time dependency on qwen-sae-interp, interplab, torch, numpy, sae_lens, or transformer_lens.
